value.title: Phase 3 — Close-out: PR surface, corpus, docs, self-hosting audit, flow-eval
value.summary: Phase-3 task detail for ph-7103 — JIT-expanded at the phase-2 boundary.

sections.name: summary
sections.value:
Task detail for ph-7103. Each task row carries one done link to its own done_when list; every assertion names its instrument via a pressure link (or an explicit not-applicable with the real instrument in its note). Task state is computed from that list, never typed.

JIT-authored at the phase-2 boundary through the taught stage-5 stroke (file birth is still hand-authored + dd build — the add-phase gap is on record). dw- ids minted by dd add --mint, never hand-rolled. All hand-chosen ids are 71xx by prime's ordinal ruling. Two rows (tk-7173, tk-7174) were born from the phase-2 retro drain.

value.title: Corpus → PR-body AC table renderer
value.success: Goldens over the exemplar; refuses unclosed corpus.

value.title: Ship stage integration (archive path, head-SHA links)
value.success: Links click through on a real PR.

value.title: docs/how/dd chapters + justfile recipes for new commands
value.success: Every new command has a runnable recipe.

value.title: Promote structural-proof-graph to docs/how/dd/11-the-builder-proof-graph.md
value.success: Doc lands as docs/how/dd/11-the-builder-proof-graph.md (Jordan's ruling 2026-08-04: builder graph joins the dd chapter set, not a new docs/how/builder dir), updated to the shipped surface (rels, pressure, done_when, writer verbs, semantic validate, check gates) and framed as the work-graph/knowledge-graph join per the graph-engineering concepts (work graph expires, knowledge graph compounds, joined via deterministic typed citations with recorded freshness). README chapter index updated; links repaired; builder-tuning keeps a signpost.

value.title: Archive-move proof: git mv fixture + dd_link rewrite
Full just checks + warn-trio baseline verification
Self-hosting retrofit + proof: plan 071's corpus fully dd-native
value.success: backpressure + execution-log docs linked from every AC; task files with done_when; rel-typed satisfies; flight-plan gate events show a real refusal and a real pass; plan validate --complete green; doctor-clean.
value.notes: The journey itself produces most of this; the task is the final audit that nothing was hand-waved.

value.title: Flow-eval scenario: single-phase dd-native journey (blind subject, telemetry-scored)
Fences as data: builder/fence schema + mechanical out-of-fence check
value.success: A fence doc validates; the check refuses an out-of-fence change naming path + fence row (planted-bad fixture fires); an amendment is a row edit with owner/cause/expiry; a dispatch brief can cite its fence by address.
value.notes: Jordan ruled IN 2026-08-04. Born from phase-1 review finding 1 (fence violation caught only by human review) and the expiry-ownership gap — a fence row that carries cause AND expiry cannot quietly outlive its reason.

value.title: Reviews as dd: builder/review schema + verdict linkage, dogfooded on review-3
value.success: builder/review schema lands; review-3 of THIS plan is authored as a .dd.json (findings rows, verdict links, pressure on Dim-0 results); doctor-clean; a jq recipe answers which findings were refuted.
value.notes: Jordan ruled IN 2026-08-04. First dogfood is this plan's own final review — the review that closes the plan is itself rows in the graph.

value.title: Deflake exec-remote-telemetry-git.int.test.ts (DL-008/COORD-001)
value.success: The known ~50%-under-load flake and git index.lock collisions no longer fail the suite: test isolated/serialized or root-caused; 20 consecutive full-suite-load runs green.
value.notes: Born from the phase-2 drain (COORD-001) and review flake notes. Exit bar is CI green — a known flake is a standing threat to it.

value.title: flow.ts autoRenderSibling made strict (DF-016) — a failed render refuses, never drifts
value.success: All 3 flow.ts callsites treat sibling-render failure as operation failure (refusal, source untouched) instead of best-effort swallow; planted failing render fires the refusal; regression test pins it.
value.notes: Born from dogfood-log DF-016. Best-effort regen is a drift factory that contradicts the E422 no-drift promise.
